description: boss 老板：一键全屏伪装：Windows 蓝屏 / Windows 更新 / gcc 编译现场 / 黑客帝国代码雨 / 黑洞吸积盘 / ASCII 水族馆；退出按键序列与自动消失时间可配置。
author: ra9fael

hint.zh: 逗号分隔的 触发词=场景，默认只用英文缩写和拼音首字母：bsod/lp、wu/gx、gcc/by、mr/dmy、bh/hd、aq/szg；自定义设置可增加词
hint.en: Comma-separated token=scene pairs; defaults use English abbreviations and pinyin initials: bsod/lp, wu/gx, gcc/by, mr/dmy, bh/hd, aq/szg; custom settings may add words

hint.zh: 伪装界面下直接键入该序列即退出（不区分大小写）；留空用默认 deadbeef
hint.en: Type this sequence on the cover to exit (case-insensitive); empty uses the default deadbeef

hint.zh: 0 表示一直伪装到手动退出
hint.en: 0 keeps the cover until dismissed manually

hint.zh: 编译输出里显示的目标名
hint.en: The target name shown in the build output

hint.zh: mouse=只盖鼠标所在的屏幕，all=盖住所有显示器
hint.en: mouse=cover only the screen with the mouse, all=cover every display

title.zh: 请求 UAC 增强输入防护

hint.zh: 开：每次启动伪装先请求一次 UAC，允许后失焦也能拦截退出序列；关：不弹 UAC，只在封面有焦点时拦截按键
hint.en: On: request UAC once per cover start; after consent the exit sequence is matched even without focus. Off: no UAC prompt; keys are suppressed only while the cover has focus.
1–36, as the original firmware's setting; default 16

hint.zh: bsod/lp 蓝屏 · wu/gx 系统更新 · gcc/by gcc 编译 · mr/dmy 代码雨 · bh/hd 黑洞 · aq/szg 水族馆；Enter 全屏伪装，输入退出序列返回
hint.en: bsod/lp bluescreen · wu/gx Windows Update · gcc/by build · mr/dmy Matrix rain · bh/hd black hole · aq/szg ASCII aquarium; Enter covers the screen, type the exit sequence to return
